title: The Migration in June: Grumeti Crossings
excerpt: In June, many herds move through the Western Corridor and cross the Grumeti River. A quieter alternative to the Mara crossings.
body:
June is a month of transition. The rains are over, the plains dry out and the herds keep moving.

## The Western Corridor

Many herds move west into the Western Corridor and cross the Grumeti River. Large crocodiles live here. See [the Western Corridor](/blog/western-corridor-grumeti/).

## Central Serengeti

Part of the herds also moves through central and northern areas. Movements vary by year.

## Weather

Dry, pleasant days and cool nights. A good start to the dry season.

## Busy?

Less busy than July and August. Some lodges have lower rates in June.

## Combine

With Ngorongoro, Tarangire (elephants arrive with the dry season) and Zanzibar.

[Plan your June safari](/travel-proposal/).
